focus_areas: Verification of external ear pinnae (critical for sea lion vs. seal distinction)
Texture consistency of wet fur (checking for AI smearing or repetition)
Edge integrity between dark fur and dark background

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the fur. Real wet fur usually has high-frequency detail and irregular clumping. AI often generates 'noisy' or 'painterly' wet fur. Also, verify the ear flap structure; AI sometimes merges the ear into the head or makes it asymmetrical in a non-biological way. Check if the whiskers emerge naturally from the muzzle or appear pasted on.

Key features visible include wet, sleek fur, prominent whiskers, a visible external ear flap, and a broad snout. The lighting creates strong highlights on the wet fur and face.
